# arshia.wav

> arshia.wav is a Dubai-based DJ playing regular nights at Moe's on the 5th (Sheraton Grand, Sheikh Zayed Road) and Soho Garden (Meydan). Expect open-format sets built for the dancefloor: house grooves, afro and latin edits and hip-hop and R&B drops, mixed live.

arshia.wav (also written "Arshia" or "arshia wav") is a DJ based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Genres: House, Afro House, Hip-Hop, R&B, Open Format.

## Residencies
- Moe's on the 5th: 5th Floor, Sheraton Grand Hotel, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai.
- Soho Garden: Meydan Racecourse, Al Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba, Dubai.

## Upcoming dates
- Dates announced weekly on Instagram @arshia.wav

## Guest list
Free guest list at https://netkenny1.github.io/Arshia-s-funnel/guestlist/ (name, Instagram handle, date, group size). Smart dress code. Soho Garden is 21+.

## FAQ
Q: Who is arshia.wav?
A: arshia.wav is a Dubai-based DJ who plays regular nights at Moe's on the 5th and Soho Garden. His sets are open format: house, afro house, hip-hop and R&B, mixed live for the room.

Q: Where does arshia.wav play in Dubai?
A: Mainly at Moe's on the 5th, the rooftop venue on the 5th floor of the Sheraton Grand Hotel on Sheikh Zayed Road, and at Soho Garden at Meydan Racecourse. Upcoming dates are listed on the Events page.

Q: How do I get on arshia.wav's guest list?
A: Use the guest list form on this site or message the WhatsApp number on the Guest List page with your name, Instagram handle, the date and how many people. You'll get a confirmation before the night.

Q: Is there a dress code?
A: Yes. Both venues run a smart dress code: no sportswear, shorts, flip-flops or caps. Soho Garden is 21+. Arrive early for guaranteed entry on guest list.

Q: What music does arshia.wav play?
A: Open format built around house and afro house, with hip-hop and R&B drops and latin edits depending on the room and the hour.

Q: How do I book arshia.wav for a private event or brand activation?
A: Email the bookings address on the Press page or DM @arshia.wav on Instagram with the date, venue and set length.
